dz: Fatimid Caliph al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah的死讯已公布.
de: The death of the Fatimid caliph al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah, kept secret for six weeks, is announced, along with the succession of his son, al-Zahir li-i'zaz Din Allah.
